```{r}
responses = list.dirs(out('era_comparison'), recursive = FALSE, full.names = FALSE)
responses = setdiff(responses, 'joint_correction_effects')
read_era = function(file) map_dfr(responses, ~ readr::read_csv(file.path(out('era_comparison'), .x, file), show_col_types = FALSE))
```

## Residual covariance comparison

MA(1) is the primary structure for Holocene-containing fits; independent and continuous-time AR(1)
residuals are fitted on identical observations for comparison.

```{r}
read_era('covariance_comparison.csv') |>
  transmute(Response = metric, Covariance = model_type, n, AIC, `Δ AIC` = delta_AIC,
    `Correlation parameter` = correlation_parameter, Status = covariance_status, Selected = selected) |>
  show_table('covariance_comparison', digits = 2, caption = '**Covariance families compared for each response.**')
show_figure('report/figures/models/fig_tracking_model_aic.pdf', page = 1:5)
```

## Group means, coefficients and contrasts

```{r}
read_era('model_group_means.csv') |>
  transmute(Response = metric, Site = site, Era = era, Estimate = estimate, SE = std_error,
    `95% CI low` = conf_low, `95% CI high` = conf_high, n) |>
  show_table('era_group_means', caption = '**Fitted means by era and park.**')
read_era('model_coefficients.csv') |>
  select(any_of(c(Response = 'metric', Term = 'term', Estimate = 'estimate', SE = 'std_error',
    p = 'p_value', `95% CI low` = 'conf_low', `95% CI high` = 'conf_high'))) |>
  show_table('era_coefficients', caption = '**Coefficients of the era models.**')
show_figure('report/figures/models/fig_tracking_model_group_means.pdf', page = 1:5)
show_figure('report/figures/models/fig_tracking_model_contrasts.pdf', page = 1:5)
show_figure('report/figures/models/fig_tracking_model_coefficients.pdf', page = 1:5)
```
